paper.title_en: Four-derivative corrections to the neutral-scalar Christodoulou threshold in charged de Sitter black holes
paper.abstract_en: We study leading parity-even four-derivative corrections to the linear Christodoulou regularity criterion for a neutral, massless, minimally coupled spectator scalar in four-dimensional charged de Sitter black holes. We derive the corrected static solution, cold extremality relation, near-horizon geometry, Cauchy-horizon surface gravity, and neutral scalar quasinormal spectrum within Einstein-Maxwell effective theory. Near cold extremality, the scalar equation reduces analytically to the finite-temperature anti-de Sitter two-dimensional throat problem. We find that the dominant nonstationary spherically symmetric mode retains its cold-limit regularity ratio through first order, while higher angular sectors respond to the deformation of the relative throat radii. The finite-distance neutral-scalar Christodoulou boundary nevertheless shifts because the relevant exterior scalar spectrum and the unequal horizon surface gravities enter the regularity ratio. At smaller and intermediate cosmological scales, positive effective coefficients move the Christodoulou threshold to larger normalized separation of the Cauchy and event horizons. Toward the larger cosmological-scale part of the cold branch, the same coefficient directions move that threshold back toward the cold endpoint. The reversal accompanies a transition in the quasinormal family that supplies the spectral gap. We further show that the coefficient combination governing the fixed-charge extremal mass parameter differs generically from those governing the cold throat and the finite-distance neutral-scalar boundary. Extremality therefore does not determine a universal direction for the neutral-scalar Christodoulou-threshold correction. Our results identify cosmological scale and spectral-family competition as essential elements in relating effective gravity, black-hole extremality, and Cauchy-horizon regularity in this spectator sector.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文研究带电de Sitter黑洞中中性标量Christodoulou正则性判据的四导数修正，导出了修正静态解、冷极限关系、近视界几何、Cauchy视界表面引力和中性标量准正规模谱，并讨论了宇宙学尺度与谱族竞争对Christodoulou阈值的影响。选题直接涉及Cauchy视界正则性与强宇宙监督猜想等广义相对论基础问题，理论推导系统且包含解析约化，对相关方向研究者具有明确阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 带电de Sitter黑洞中中性标量Christodoulou阈值的四导数修正
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维带电de Sitter黑洞中，对中性、无质量、最小耦合旁观标量的线性Christodoulou正则性判据的领头宇称偶四导数修正。我们在Einstein-Maxwell有效理论框架内，推导了修正后的静态解、冷极限关系、近视界几何、Cauchy视界表面引力以及中性标量准正规模谱。在接近冷极限时，标量方程可解析地约化为有限温度的anti-de Sitter二维喉部问题。我们发现，主导的非定常球对称模式在一阶近似下保持其冷极限正则性比，而更高角动量扇区则响应相对喉部半径的形变。然而，有限距离的中性标量Christodoulou边界仍然发生移动，因为相关的外部标量谱以及不相等的视界表面引力进入了正则性比。在较小和中等宇宙学尺度上，正的有效系数将Christodoulou阈值推向更大的Cauchy视界与事件视界归一化分离。朝冷分支中较大的宇宙学尺度部分，相同的系数方向又将该阈值推回冷端点。这一反转伴随着提供谱间隙的准正规模族的转变。我们进一步表明，控制固定电荷极端质量参数的系数组合，一般不同于控制冷喉部和有限距离中性标量边界的系数组合。因此，极端性并不能确定中性标量Christodoulou阈值修正的普适方向。我们的结果确认，宇宙学尺度和谱族竞争是将有效引力、黑洞极端性和Cauchy视界正则性联系起来的必要要素，在这一旁观标量扇区中尤为如此。
